caption: Fresher data analyst - 3 tips

transcript.text: Dekho bhai, fresher data analyst role ke liye teen cheezein chahiye.
SQL solid hona chahiye, Python basics clear, aur ek achha project portfolio.
Resume mein yeh teeno highlight karo, recruiter ko turant pasand aata hai.
Aur haan, LinkedIn profile bhi update kar do.
